name: Audio Communication
description:
Audiotechnique: types of transducers, sound recording, measurement technology.
Auditory physiology: peripheral and central hearing system.
Psychoacoustics: auditory field, masking, critical bands, loudness, pitch, pitch strength, sharpness, subjective duration, fluctuation strength, roughness, binaural effects.
Applications: selection of recent research achievements in audiology, sound quality design, room acoustics, speech evaluation, audiotechnique.
prerequisites: Mathematische Grundlagen (komplexe Rechnung), Grundlagen der Signaldarstellung (Fouriertransformation)
